name: terminal-approval
//: The released crate (lib allowlister_terminal_approval + bin allowlister-terminal-approval-plugin) and its unit tests. Tagged type:contract: its public library surface (local_prompt, PromptLabels) is the prompt contract allowlister-remote consumes, so the boundary rules keep it from depending on any project in this repo. As the root project it also owns every file no nested project claims (the justfile, README, Cargo.lock, scripts/); agent notes and agent/hook/judge settings are in .nxignore, so they reach nothing. Its cache inputs are narrowed to what the crate compiles from.

build.//: target/debug/allowlister-terminal-approval-plugin: what terminal-approval-e2e:test depends on, so a broken binary build fails here, by name, before any journey runs.

test.//: The lib + bin unit tests under cargo-llvm-cov --no-report: the raw profiles land in target/llvm-cov-target for coverage:coverage to merge with the e2e crate's.

release-check.//: The optimized release build (the shipped profile) for the host — the artifact check the gate ran before the graph; publish.yml's per-target builds go through `just build-release <target>`.
